desc: Derive and validate the case-based closed form from the finite-field walk expansion, including p=2, p=3, and p>3.
Reformulate the validated formulas using ordinary matrix multiplication, diagonal masks, and entrywise operations.
Design an O(N^3 log p) modular matrix exponentiation implementation suitable for N<=100.
Write the final Python stdin/stdout solution with careful modular arithmetic and output formatting.
